title: RELATED over a table evaluated under USERELATIONSHIP follows the relationship that was active when the table was evaluated
query: VAR SalesByDelivery = CALCULATETABLE ( Sales, USERELATIONSHIP ( Sales[DeliveryDate], 'Date'[Date] ) )

source.quote: Date[Month] contained in SalesB is related to Sales[DueDate], not to Sales[Date]
source.supports: the article's SalesB example: the related Date columns of the variable come from the relationship active when it was evaluated

derivation: Each row's Month is the month of its DeliveryDate, although the SELECTCOLUMNS runs when OrderDate is the active relationship: row 1 2023-02-10 Feb, row 2 2023-01-15 Jan, row 3 2023-12-31 Dec, row 4 2024-01-05 Jan, row 5 2024-02-20 Feb, row 6 2024-03-01 Mar, row 7 2024-03-01 Mar.
notes: An engine that resolves RELATED with the relationships active at the point of the call would return the OrderDate months: Jan, Jan, Feb, Dec, Jan, Feb, Mar. The article says that reading is wrong.
